chain.label: Main rudder PCU servo valve susceptible to secondary slide jam/overtravel
chain.trigger: jam of the main rudder power control unit servo valve secondary slide to the servo valve housing offset from its neutral position and overtravel of the primary slide

chain.label: Wake vortex encounter from preceding Delta flight 1083
chain.trigger: USAir flight 427 most likely encountered the wake vortices produced by Delta flight 1083 about the time of the initial upset

chain.label: First officer applied rapid right rudder pedal input countering wake-induced yaw
chain.trigger: the flight crew responded to the nose left yawing motion with a right rudder pedal input about 1903:00

caused_by.evidence: just after 1902:58, the wake vortex produced a nose left heading change. This simulation assumed that the flight crew responded to the nose left yawing motion with a right rudder pedal input

chain.label: Rudder reversed and moved to blowdown limit opposite pilot command
chain.trigger: the rudder surface most likely deflected in a direction opposite to that commanded by the pilots as a result of a jam of the main rudder power control unit servo valve secondary slide

caused_by.evidence: the servo valve secondary slide momentarily jammed to the servo valve housing and that the subsequent overtravel of the primary slide resulted in an increase in system return flow that could cause a rudder actuator reversal

this scenario further assumed that the secondary slide was jammed to the servo valve housing and that the flight crew's rudder pedal input resulted in a rudder motion reversal, with the rudder reaching its blowdown limit

chain.label: Loss of control of the airplane from rudder at blowdown limit
chain.trigger: a loss of control of the airplane resulting from the movement of the rudder surface to its blowdown limit

caused_by.evidence: the initial wake vortex-related left yaw...was followed about 1 second later by movement of the rudder to its left blowdown limit, which resulted in a continuing left yaw/heading change

chain.label: Aerodynamic stall during uncontrolled roll
chain.trigger: The airplane entered an aerodynamic stall about 1903:08 and rolled more rapidly to the left

caused_by.evidence: the airplane rolled to about 20° of left bank, back to 15° left bank, and then farther to the left. The airplane entered an aerodynamic stall about 1903:08 and rolled more rapidly to the left

chain.label: Uncontrolled descent and impact with terrain near Aliquippa, PA
chain.trigger: About 1903:23, the airplane impacted hilly, wooded terrain near Aliquippa, Pennsylvania

caused_by.evidence: The airplane entered an uncontrolled descent and impacted terrain near Aliquippa, Pennsylvania

chain.label: Fatal injuries to all 132 occupants
chain.trigger: All 132 people on board were killed, and the airplane was destroyed by impact forces and fire
